item1.reason: The patient prefers an afternoon visit ending before dinner to avoid becoming too tired.

evidence.quote: An afternoon visit would suit me best, not too long. I’d enjoy seeing my sister and having a chat, then head home before dinner, before I get too tired.

item2.reason: The patient explicitly says they usually return to sleep after waking around dawn.

evidence.quote: I’ve been waking around dawn some mornings, but I usually get back to sleep.
